Разрезы МИ (только позиции МИ): "miType" — по коду вида НКМИ (с его классификацией), "miClassification" — по подразделу классификации, "miSection" — по разделу. "signedYear" / "signedMonth" — ряд по годам или месяцам подписания (key «2026» / «2026-03», группы по времени; если периодов больше groupSize — последние). "regHolder" — владелец РУ (вероятный), "manufacturer" — производитель (вероятный): те же поля, что в BI, считаются по аналитической витрине и не работают со свободным текстом q search_tender_tech_specs: description, inputSchema +У медизделий — вид МИ: miTypeCode (6-значный код по НКМИ), miTypeName и классификация miSection/miSubsection. Строк выдачи — не больше 200 (10 страниц по 20); для сводной задайте groupBy — итоги по виду МИ или классификации считаются на сервере по ВСЕЙ выборке и приходят в groups (если строки не нужны — pageSize: 1). parameters: +input.groupBy input.groupBy description: Сводная по всей выборке; в каждой группе key — значение разреза. Разрезы МИ (только позиции МИ): "miType" — по коду вида НКМИ (с его классификацией), "miClassification" — по подразделу классификации, "miSection" — по разделу. По каждой группе: rows, sum, qty, notifications (оценка, погрешность до 2–3 %); groupsTotal, totalRows/totalSum и otherRows/otherSum — чтобы итог по группам сходился с итогом выборки. Если сводная не посчиталась, причина — в groupsError input.groupBy enum: ["miType", "miClassification", "miSection"] input.groupSize input.groupSize

Fill it from what you read on the item or the user's photo; leave it empty rather than guess. input.model input.model description: The model or product-line name as printed on the item or its box (for example "iPhone 12", "QuietComfort 35", "Odyssey G5", "501"). entry.content: claimhit_generate_chart: description, inputSchema -Requires +SPENDS 1 CHART CREDIT and asks first: the initial call returns -search_id +quote naming the target it matched -target name. +runs nothing, and the chart is generated only when you call again with confirm: true after the user agrees. parameters: +input.confirm input.confirm default: false input.confirm description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged. claimhit_get_result: description, inputSchema -full -ID. +ID, and narrow, sort and page through them. FREE and unlimited: every call is a view over results already paid for, so filter and re-read as much as the conversation needs. A search completes in phases: check the returned `status` field and call again if it is RUNNING, because background enrichment keeps finding additional implementers for several minutes after the first results appear. Only present results as final when status is COMPLETE. Results are paged — if the response carries a `more` field, there are further matches and you must not present the page you have as the complet parameters: +input.company input.company description: Only return targets whose company (or standards body) contains this text, case-insensitive. E.g. "Bosch", "Samsung". input.detail input.detail default: "summary" input.detail description: full adds the per-element scores, the evidence source and the stored evidence passages for each target — use it when asked why something scored as it did. Reading evidence is free; a Hit Chart is the paid, element-by-element analysis. input.detail enum: ["summary", "full"] input.include_held_low input.include_held_low description: Also return candidates held back for claimhit_rerun_search: description, inputSchema -results. +results, repeating the inputs that steered it — the company scope, the hint, named products, markets, company sizes and the named standard. +search, 1 search credit after that. Asks first either way: the initial call returns a quote listing the inputs it will repeat and whether it is free, and runs nothing until you call again with confirm: true. To narrow or re-read the results you already have, use claimhit_get_result instead — that is free and does not start a new -Use when the user wants to refresh results or check if new infringers have appeared. parameters: +input.confirm input.confirm default: false input.confirm description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged. +input.widen input.widen description: Drop the original company scope and search the whole market. Default false, which repeats the original scope. Use when the first search was scoped to named companies and found too little. added claimhit_refine_product

entry.content: vizier_verify_action: description +Call vizier_verify_action immediately before an AI agent executes an external action. Signed grant mode: required. Anonymous calls are evaluation-only and never grant ALLOW. An API key authenticates the integration; it is not principal delegation. In required mode, missing grants return GRANT_REQUIRED. An invalid deployment policy returns GRANT_POLICY_MISCONFIGURED; the operator must repair configuration. The principal owner generates an ES256 key outside the agent. Ask the operator to register only its public JWK under the principal id in VIZIER_PRINCIPAL_KEYS; check /docs delegation.princip

entry.content: auditBibliography: description, inputSchema, outputSchema +not_checked, +`not_checked` counts entries declined before a verdict (no identifier, container-only identifier, too sparse) — report them as unverified, never as suspect. parameters: +input.semanticTitle input.semanticTitle description: Opt-in semantic title check applied per entry (any tier; see verifyCitation). Default false. +not_checked, +`not_found` = looked up and nothing exists; `not_checked` = declined before a verdict (no identifier in the reference, a container-only identifier, or too sparse to check) — tell the user those were NOT verified rather than treating them as suspect. checkRetraction: description -For multi-paper bibliography audits (clinical guidelines, +To check a WHOLE reference list for retractions (e.g. 'check all these citations for retractions' at the end of a literature review, a guideline or a -reviews), loop +review), use auditBibliography instead — -per identifier — the tool intentionally rejects batch input to keep retraction-status results unambiguous per work. +runs the retraction check plus the fabrication check on up to 25 entries. +for a handful of papers -identifier for multiple papers. +identifier, for a bibliography use auditBibliography. -No sibling tool overlaps t verifyCitation: inputSchema parameters: +input.semanticTitle input.semanticTitle description: Opt-in semantic title check (any tier). On a string-level matched verdict, a calibrated model judgment of whether the claimed and resolved titles describe the same work; catches one-word swaps in long titles that string similarity misses. A flagged title moves matched → ambiguous (review), never mismatch. Not byte-deterministic — _provenance.semantic_title carries the probability. Default false.

전해 달라고 했을 때만** 운영자에게 보낸다. 쓰는 때: 사용자가 "이거 틀렸으니 신고해 줘", "운영자에게 알려 줘", "이런 데이터도 넣어 달라고 전해 줘"처럼 제보·요청을 부탁했을 때. 보내기 전에 무엇이 전달되는지 사용자에게 알린다. kind='결함'은 틀린 답 제보, kind='질문기록'은 개선 요청이다. 쓰지 않는 때: 사용자가 요청하지 않았는데 -넘겨 축을 확인받는다**(kind='질문기록'). **결함**: 사용자가 "그거 틀렸다", "이상하다", "숫자가 안 맞는다"고 하면 **먼저 +남기려고 부르지 않는다. 답하기 전에 먼저 부르지도 않는다 — -도구를 호출한 뒤** 정정 답변을 하라. 신고는 서버 운영자에게 전달되어 실제 수정에 쓰인다. 사용자가 지적하지 않았는데 추측으로 부르지는 말 것. **질문기록**: +도구는 답변·정정을 대신하지 않는다. 전달 내용(인자)과 같은 -원문 질문을 그대로 넘기면 서버가 **그 자리에서 라우팅을 돌려준다** (응답의 `routing`) — 어느 축·어느 도구로 가야 하는지, 그 축의 라우팅 규칙, ** parameters: +그 -**완결된 답**을 +완결된 답을 -적어라(질문은행의 ●/◐/○ 판정에 그대로 쓰인다) +적는다 -'결함'=답이 틀렸다는 신고(기본). '질문기록'=**사용자 원문 +'결함'=사용자가 답이 틀렸다고 제보해 달라고 한 경우(기본). '질문기록'=사용자가 '이런 질문에도 답하게 해 달라'·'이 데이터도 넣어 달라'처럼 **개선 요청을 전해 달라고 한 경우** — 그 질문과 무엇이 없었는지를 넘긴다(응답에 그 질문이 어느 도구 축에 해당하는지가 `routing`으로 함께 온다). 사용자가 요청하지 않은 -넘겨 어디로 가야 하는지 확인받는 값**. 원문을 주면 응답의 `routing`으로 ①질문이 9개 도구 축 중 어디인지와 그 축의 도구 이름 ②산문 지침에만 있던 라우팅 규칙(공고 질문에 추정 금지, 비아파트는 매매만, 청약·대출 갈림 등) ③**우리 데이터 밖이면 그 사실과 대신 볼 곳** ④지역명이 모호하면 후보를 돌려준다. **못 고르면 `axis: null`과 사유를 준다 — 추측으로 채우지 않는다.** 확신이 안 서거나 여러 축에 걸치는 질문이면 **도구를 여러 번 부르기 전에** 먼저 여기에 원문을 넣는 편이 답이 정확해진다. 서버는 클라이언트가 search: annotations

An audiobook whose payment was refunded also returns RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE, with no link: claim the refund at /recover with the payment ID. A web 3D purchase not yet collected on its own page also returns RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE. parameters: +or refunded send_sms: description -and message -those +the one +The message must not need more SMS segments than were paid for. Free rules, refused before payment, with no invoice: no links in the text, a send limit per destination number, and no number on our do-not-contact list. A paid send checks the limit and the list again; a refusal then refunds in full. A link added after payment is held, not refunded: a link is never sent. A US number: Queued.
